equivalents.note: Contains ibuprofen, an NSAID. US combination tablets are lower strength (Advil Dual Action 125 mg + 250 mg).
Same medicine under its US name. US inhalers state the dose leaving the mouthpiece (90 mcg); Mexico and Japan state the valve dose (100 mcg).

context.title: Recurrent low back pain
context.detail: Recurring after lifting at work; 2025 X-ray showed no injury.
context.why: Relevant to her severe current back pain.

context.title: NSAID-induced asthma
context.detail: Severe wheezing and asthma attack after aspirin; avoid aspirin and NSAIDs, including ibuprofen.
context.why: Important when considering pain treatment for her back.

context.title: Flexon contains ibuprofen
context.detail: OTC tablet contains ibuprofen 400 mg plus acetaminophen 325 mg; listed for pain as needed.
context.why: Her pain medicine may contain an NSAID despite her report of taking acetaminophen.

context.title: NSAID anaphylactoid reaction
context.detail: Severe wheezing and asthma attack after aspirin (2022); allergy includes ketorolac and other NSAIDs.
context.why: Ketorolac is an NSAID and could trigger a severe asthma attack.

context.title: Iodinated contrast reaction
context.detail: Hives and throat tightness during CT contrast (2023).
context.why: The planned contrast CT may repeat this reaction.

context.title: Contrast CT precautions
context.detail: Prior hives and throat tightness; future contrast only with premedication, or use non-contrast imaging or MRI.
context.why: This record specifies precautions for the planned contrast CT.
